name: Syndicate
summary: Across northern Lordaeron, the Syndicate holds strongholds and fights to reclaim Alterac. Dispossessed nobles lead this human criminal organization against both the Alliance and the Horde, seeking to restore their lost aristocracy.

sections.title: Fallen Nobility
sections.body:
After King Aiden Perenolde's treachery during the Second War, the kingdom of Alterac collapsed in dishonor. Its aristocracy lost its lands and titles, but the surviving nobles refused to accept exile. They gathered under the late king's son, Prince Aliden Perenolde, and forged the Syndicate.

They marked themselves with orange bandanas and filled their ranks with hired thugs, highwaymen, and hedge wizards. To outsiders, they are brigands who raid caravans, ambush travelers, and extort people. Yet their crimes exist only to fund an organized bid to reclaim their ancestral lands and subjugate the surrounding regions.

sections.title: Strongholds of the North
sections.body:
Across northern Lordaeron, the Syndicate holds fortified ground. In the snowy Alterac Mountains, they fortified the ruined town of Strahnbrad and set camps in the Uplands and Dandred's Fold. Farther south, they hold the crumbling Durnholde Keep in the Hillsbrad Foothills. From there, they harass Southshore and raid supply routes.

Farther east, beyond Thoradin's Wall, Lord Falconcrest commands an occupying Syndicate army in the historic ruins of Stromgarde Keep. There, they battle the battered Stromgarde Militia for control of the Arathi Highlands.

sections.title: Enemies on All Fronts
sections.body:
The Syndicate's ambitions reach beyond ordinary outlawry, earning them the hatred of nearly every regional faction. They call the Alliance their mortal enemy, believing it stole their rightful heritage. Their attacks often target Southshore officials such as Magistrate Henry Maleb.

Toward the Horde, their scorn is open. Following Aedelas Blackmoore's philosophy, they see orcs as beasts fit for slave labor and seek to restore the internment camps. Sylvanas Windrunner's Forsaken execute captured Syndicate members on sight. Ravenholdt's clandestine thieves' guild wages a shadow war against Syndicate operatives it considers sloppy and arrogant.

sections.title: Puppets of the Shadow Council
sections.body:
The Syndicate's noble leaders believe they fight for human supremacy and their birthright. Yet cultists of the Argus Wake have infiltrated the upper ranks and steer men such as Lord Falconcrest toward seizing Stromgarde Keep.

The Argus Wake answers to the Shadow Council in Jaedenar, within Felwood. It uses the Syndicate's armies and stolen lands as a mortal vanguard, clearing the way for the Burning Legion.

aliases: who are these guys in orange
faq.answer: The Syndicate is a criminal organization of dispossessed nobles, brigands, and mercenaries from fallen Alterac. Exiled aristocrats such as Prince Aliden Perenolde and Lord Falconcrest lead them. They use highway robbery, assassination, and military occupation to try to rebuild Alterac.

faq.q: Why does the Syndicate hate the Alliance?
faq.answer: Alterac betrayed the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War, and the Alliance dismantled the kingdom and stripped its nobles of their lands. Syndicate leaders consider the Alliance their mortal enemy and sabotage its towns, trade caravans, and garrisons such as Stromgarde Keep.

faq.q: Why does the Syndicate capture and enslave orcs?
aliases: why are orcs in cages in strahnbrad
faq.answer: The Syndicate follows the harsh philosophy of former Durnholde commander Aedelas Blackmoore, who viewed orcs as savage beasts fit only for unpaid servitude. Prince Aliden Perenolde sought to restore the Alliance internment camps, using enslaved orcs captured in the Hillsbrad Foothills and Alterac as forced labor.

faq.q: What is the Syndicate's relationship with Ravenholdt?
faq.answer: Ravenholdt is a prestigious guild of professional assassins and thieves in the Alterac Mountains. Its members consider the Syndicate amateurish and undisciplined, and contract rogues to steal Syndicate emblems. The Syndicate's leaders ruthlessly cull operatives who lose theirs.

faq.q: Who is really pulling the strings behind the Syndicate?
faq.answer: The Syndicate publicly answers to exiled Alteraci nobles such as Prince Aliden Perenolde and Lord Falconcrest. They believe they are fighting to reclaim their lost titles. Yet whispers in the Arathi Highlands hint at darker hands behind their hold on Stromgarde, and travelers can look into it at the Syndicate's strongholds there.

faq.q: Where are the Syndicate's primary strongholds?
faq.answer: The Syndicate's main strongholds lie across the Alterac Mountains, the Hillsbrad Foothills, and the Arathi Highlands. They hold Strahnbrad and Dandred's Fold in Alterac, Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad, and Northfold Manor in Arathi. Under Lord Falconcrest, they also occupy a large part of Stromgarde Keep.

angles.text: Ravenholdt pays thieves to slip behind enemy lines and steal emblems from Syndicate brigands, taking advantage of their fear of losing rank.
The Syndicate sees your people as beasts destined for chains and internment. Freeing captured brethren in Strahnbrad and Durnholde is a matter of honor.
Syndicate operatives murdered Southshore's former magistrate and keep pushing the beleaguered Stromgarde Militia toward extinction in the Arathi Highlands.
Warchief Thrall and Lady Sylvanas both maintain active bounties against the Syndicate. They send scouts to destroy its camps and recover stolen relics.
